eventName: Essentials of Internal Audit - Virtual (US CPE)
AboutCourse: Essentials of Internal Audit is a foundational course designed to build or refresh on the knowledge and practical skills internal audit professionals need to contribute effectively to high-quality engagements. Aligned with Deloitte IA methodologies and the Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS), the course introduces the purpose of internal audit, key engagement types, and the end-to-end engagement lifecycle. Learners will explore risk identification, risk and control fundamentals, testing methodologies, and the roles and responsibilities of staff and senior team members. In addition, the course covers IA deliverables, documentation expectations, independence considerations, audit reporting, and the development of clear, quality observations and recommendations. Learners will also be able to appreciate how these concepts come together on a real engagement.
